translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Yohanes
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I YOHANES

content: Yesus nobatundun tia wiwine samba Samaria
Mian Farisi nomorongor se' mian men ia tausi i Yesus bo murit-Na ka' men Ia sarani a biai'na tia men ia sarani i Yohanes.
(Ya'apo i Yesus sianta nansarani mian, tongko' murit-Na.)
Sarataa ia inti'i i Yesus se' mian Farisi nomorongormo se' koiya'a, Ia namarereimo Yudea ka' nomule'kon soosoodo na Galilea.
Yesus tio lumiu na Samaria mule'kon na Galilea.
Mbaka' notakamo i Ia na Sikhar, sa'angu' kota na Samaria. Sikhar iya'a sianta oloa na tano' men mbaripian ia rookon i Yakub boni Yusuf anakna.

Inda'a isian lobong tambu'an ni Yakub. Yesus nopamalemo tuu' gause nogintano' oloa. Mbali' iya'a, Ia no'umoruangmo ka' nintimale na soripi'na lobong iya'a. Tempo iya'a toro jaam duabelaas tanga'iloa'.
Sian nanau' notakamo a sa'angu' wiwine samba Samaria mae' tumambu'. Yesus norobumo na wiwine iya'a tae-Na, “Sida i Yaku' mama'ase' minginum?”
Tempo iya'a i Yesus somo suusuungna gause murit-Na nomae'mo na kota mingili kakaan.
Taena wiwine iya'a, “Tuan! Kuu samba Yahudi. Nongko'upa se' i Kuu mama'ase' minginum weer na ingku' wiwine na Samaria?” (Gause samba Yahudi sianta pooka'amat tia samba Samaria.)

Taeni Yesus, “Kalu koo inti'i a upa men ia rookon Alaata'ala, ka' koo inti'i se' i ime a men mama'ase' minginum weer na ko'oom, sabole i koo mama'ase' minginum na Ko'ona, ka' i koo taraion-Na weer men mantatakon tutuo' men pore.”
Taena wiwine iya'a, “Kuu Tuan sianta sasabuan, ka' lobong kani'i alalom tuu'. Mbaria a pantausian-Muu weer men mantatakon tutuo' men pore?
Yakub, pulimai, nongorookon lobong kani'i bo ko'omai. Ia mbaripian tia anakna tumambu' ka'ita, bo inumonna i raaya'a tia ayopna. Surion-Muu Tuan, se' i Kuu mbali' a balaki'na tii Yakub?”
Taeni Yesus, “Mian men minginum weer kani'i bo moro'u soosoodo,
kasee mian men minginum weer men rookonon-Ku, sianmo moro'u pataka sidutu. Gause weer men rookonon-Ku iya'a bo sida matana weer na lalomna wakana men umembuar mantarai tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu.”
Taena wiwine iya'a, “Tuan, taraimo i yaku' weer iya'a kada' i yaku' sianmo moro'u soosoodo, ka' kada' sianmo sakat ra'amari tumambu'.”
Taeni Yesus, “Rae'mo, ka' leelo' a langkai'im ra'amari.”
Taena wiwine iya'a, “Yaku' sian langkai'an.” Taeni Yesus, “Tuutuu' a upa men taeem,
gause i koo noko pirilima'mo nosuo' ka' moro'one men poototobo' tii koo koini'i taasi'po langkai'im.”
Taena wiwine iya'a, “Ni'isi ka' yaku' inti'i se' i Kuu sa'angu' nabii.
Pulimai monsoosa' Alaata'ala na buu'na kani'i, kasee i kuu samba Yahudi nangaan se' tongko' na Yerusalem a ponsoosa'anna mian Alaata'ala.”
Taeni Yesus, “Parasayamo, bo taka a tempona se' mian bo monsoosa' Tama na surugaa taasi'mo tongko' na buu'na kani'i ka' uga' taasi'mo tongko' na Yerusalem.

Kuu lipu' Samaria monsoosa' upa men sian kuu inti'i, kasee i kai lipu' Yahudi monsoosa' i Ia men kai inti'i. Kai monsoosa' men kai inti'i iya'a gause kasalamatan men ia takakon Alaata'ala ringkat na lipu' Yahudi.
Bo taka a tempona, ka' koini'i notakamo, se' mian bo monsoosa' Tama na surugaa koi men tuutuu'na ka' tia kuasana Alus Molinas. Ponsoosa' men koiya'a kikira'na Tama na surugaa.
Gause Alaata'ala iya'a Alus, mbaka' tongko' tia kuasana Alus Molinas a mian sida monsoosa' i Ia koi men tuutuu'na.”
Wiwine iya'a ninsimbatimo i Yesus taena, “Yaku' inti'i se' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon, men uga' ngaanon Kristus bo taka. Kalu i Ia takamo, Ia bo mambantilkon giigii' upa na ko'onta'.”
Taeni Yesus, “Yaku'mo mba'a inono' men koini'i pintanga' batundun tii koo.”

Pintanga' i Yesus batundun tia wiwinena Samaria iya'a, notakamo a murit-Na. Raaya'a samba' nimiile' se' i Yesus batundun tia wiwine. Kasee sianta sa'angu'po i raaya'a men nimikirawar na wiwine iya'a, “Ibu, upa a panduungmuu?” kabai men nimikirawar ni Yesus, “Nongko'upa i Kuu se' batundun tia wiwine kanono'?”
Mbaka' wiwine iya'a namarereimo gumbangna indo'o, ka' notumetende' mae' na kota ka' nambantilkon na mian taena,
“Mai piile' a mian kuaro'o men nambantilkon na ingku' giigii' men yaku' wawaumo. Too i Iamo a Tomundo' Pansalamatkon?”
Mbaka' i raaya'a namarereimo kota ka' nomae' ni Yesus.
Pintanga' iya'a, Yesus ia taropimo murit-Na bo kumaan. Taena i raaya'a, “Guru, mai kumaanmo!”
Mbaka' ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Yaku' daa isian kakaan kasee men sian inti'ionmuu.”
Mbaka' murit ni Yesus nopoopikirawarimo taena, “Isian mbali' mian sambana men nangawawa kakaan bo Ko'ona?”
Kasi i Yesus norobu tae-Na, “Kakaan-Ku mase mongololoikon pingkira'-Na men nomosuu' i Yaku', ka' mamakabus palimangon men Ia rookon bo limangon-Ku.
Tempo i kuu mimiile' ale', kuu mangaan se' somo paat bitu'on mamadakmo. Kasee bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu: Alaka' piile' tiku-tikum! Giigii' ale' somo potosongi', noko toropotmo bo padakon!
Mian men mamadak noko pangalabotmo tambona, ka' nantambun ule' bona tutuo'na men pore pataka sidutu. Mbaka' mian men nangasok ka' mian men namadak koikoimo munsuri beles.
Men koiya'a kana'mo tia timbaani' kani'imari: ‘Men sa'angu' mangasok, men sambana mamadak.’
Yaku' nomosuu' i kuu mae' mamadak na ale' men taasi' i kuu a ningilimang. Mian sambana noko balimangmo inda'a, kasee i kuu mangala ule'na limangna i raaya'a.”
Biai' a samba Samaria na kota iya'a men noparasaya ni Yesus, gause isian tundunanna wiwine iya'a men taena, “Ia nambantilkon na ingku' giigii' upa men yaku' wawaumo.”
Mbaka' sarataa samba Samaria nopootuung tii Yesus, raaya'a nama'ase'mo kada' i Ia sabole-bole dumodongo tii raaya'a. Mbaka' i Yesus notuukmo ruangilio na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Tempo iya'a, nokanturanganmo biai' a mian men parasaya ni Yesus, gause upa men pisiso'konon-Na na ko'ona i raaya'a.

Raaya'a norobumo na wiwine iya'a taena, “Kai koini'i parasaya, taasi'mo tongko' upa men koo bantilkon na ko'omai, kasee daa kai rongormo a upa men tae-Na, ka' daa kai inti'imo se' tuutuu' Iamo a Pansalamatkon dunia.”
Mule'kon na Galilea
Sarataa i Yesus ruangiliomo na Sikhar, Ia nomule'konmo na Galilea.
Yesus isian nangaan tae-Na, “Sa'angu' nabii sian angga'ion na dodongoanna suungna.”

Kasee tempo i Yesus taka na Galilea, mian biai' nangalabotimo i Ia tia noa ma'amat, gause i raaya'a uga' nimiile'mo giigii' men ia wawau i Yesus tempo pangaramekonan Paska na Yerusalem, ka' i raaya'a uga' isian na ramean iya'a.
Yesus nengelesi'i anakna pagawena batomundo'an

Mbaka' i Yesus nomule'konmo soosoodo na kota Kana men na Galilea, men mbaripian nangawawauan-Na weer nosida anggur. Tempo iya'a isian sa'angu' pagawena batomundo'an men anakna pintanga' manggeo na Kapernaum.
Sarataa i ia nomorongor se' i Yesus notakamo na Galilea ringkat na Yudea, ia nomae'mo na Ko'ona ka' nama'ase' kada' i Ia mae' na Kapernaum mengelesi'i anakna men sakaalmo.
Yesus norobumo na pagawena batomundo'an iya'a tae-Na, “Kalu i kuu sian mimiile' upa kosamba' men wawauon-Ku, kuu sian mamarasaya.”
Ia simbati pagawena batomundo'an iya'a taena, “Tumpu, indamo dongan, kada' takaionta a anakku sianpo lapus.”
Taeni Yesus, “Rae', ule'konmo. Anaak palesi'mo.” Pagawe iya'a parasaya men taeni Yesus, kasi i ia nomae'.
Na tanga'na salan, toro pii mian men balimang na ko'ona nomootuungi i ia ka' nambantilkon na ko'ona taena, “Anakmuu daa palesi'mo.”
Kasi i ia nimikirawar na ko'ona i raaya'a se' jaam pipii a nuntumbeianna nalesi'. Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Rimberi'po toro jaam satu tanga'iloa', sianmo nosuminggar.”
Kasi tamana anak iya'a notonginau' se' toro jaam koiya'a a men nangaanan ni Yesus na ko'ona men tae-Na, “Anaak palesi'mo.” Mbaka' i ia tia giigii' poto'utusanna noparasayamo ni Yesus.
Ya'amo a kopinduanna i Yesus nangawawau upa kosamba' na Galilea sarataa notaka ringkat na Yudea.
